motion_rule: a wild animal grazes on subscriptions and never learns who is charging him. He stands in one spot all clip; the drift of paper moves across frame instead. New shot size each beat, his head half the frame
character: a shaggy musk ox, heavy skirt of guard hair swinging late behind him, slow single blinks, jaw grinding sideways
second_characters: ONE lemming behind his ear, calm and clerical, planting a card every time he blinks
props: ONE gold card in the corner of his mouth from 1.80 to 8.20; A DRIFT of cards and receipt tape
prop_continuity: cards only ever increase on him; the card he spits at 9.10 blows back at 9.80
environment: open sunlit tundra at noon, blinding flat snow to the horizon
light_events: blinding noon off the snow, hard white bounce under his jaw

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and well fed, no complaint, biting off each word, 3.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pod-PEE-sok, TSE-ly, sug-ROP, ZNA-yu, da-YUT, pla-CHU — stress CHU, he pays, not weeping
audio.pacing: 1.80-4.60, 5.70-7.30 and 7.30-8.20 each one breath; after 8.20 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and his lips shape every syllable around the card, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wind, crust breaking, plastic crunching, a swallow, three soft taps

timeline.a: his hoof punches through the crust, throwing a fan of snow and paper; only the leg works
his muzzle goes into the hole up to the eyes and ploughs sideways, exactly like an ox after lichen
he pulls his muzzle out with a fan of plastic cards and crumpled receipt tape in his lips
he starts chewing, jaw circling sideways, plastic cracking, one gold card left sticking out
he shifts his weight and the heavy skirt of hair swings after him, late
he punches the crust a second time out of pure habit, not meaning to eat
the crust gives way, his leg drops to the knee and he hauls it out, the mountain rocking
he swallows with effort, the lump travelling down his throat, and goes on grinding
he blinks once, slowly, and the lemming plants a card in his fur; half a second later his ear twitches
he lifts his muzzle and swings it sideways, receipt tape frozen in his beard unrolling two metres
the gold card travels to the other corner of his mouth while he chews
he keeps chewing without a trace of complaint
he blinks again and the lemming plants a second card, patting it flat
he looks into the lens and says nothing; his tongue pushes a chewed receipt onto his lip
he twists his muzzle to his shoulder and tears one card out of his fur with his teeth
he spits it away on the wind and lifts his head, chest out, a small victory
the lemming licks its paw, counts off three cards like a teller and plants them, tap, tap, tap
he does not turn, lowers his muzzle back into the hole, and the card he spat sticks in his skirt

must_appear: what he digs out is cards and receipts, not lichen; he swallows them; the lemming plants a card on every blink; at 9.45 it counts off three; the spat card returns
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a suffering animal, blood, injury, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a walking hero, a closed muzzle while speaking, a hoof over his mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text
